name: BIC Complaints Inquiries
description:
This dataset contains records of complaints and inquiries filed against trade waste businesses, likely in New York City, with 5,000 sampled rows and 42 columns. Each record captures a complaint or inquiry number, the date it was filed, its source (such as 311 phone lines, direct phone calls, web-mail, or mail), the nature of the issue (for example billing, contracts, service, or misinformation), and how it was resolved. Dispositions include outcomes like resolved, referred to another agency, unsubstantiated, referred to licensing, or violation written, and most records show a closed status along with a response time in days.

The data also includes details about the business involved, such as account name, license type (mostly trade waste, with some transfer station and market licenses), account status, business address and phone, and a BIC number. Many records include the complainant's location—street, city, state, ZIP, borough—and, for a smaller subset, geographic identifiers
